next_approach_envelope.scope: Open fingers, high alignment and downward-tool world-yaw rotation only; no descent.

gaps: Missing or invalid named surface depths; see observe.samples0

assumptions: All positions are world meters; pixels have top-left origin and their saved camera/frame.
Measurements are visible surfaces, not hidden collision geometry.
Uncertainty margins are conservative engineering allowances, not calibrated confidence bounds.
No motion, grasp, retention, or base contact is established by this observation stage.
Landing size uses the rim-enclosed visible bowl silhouette, not an invented hidden base; recheck the bowl extent after lifting.

x.instructions: For world axis x, use its supplied goal_relation only: increase means positive, decrease means negative, within_tolerance means hold. Do not infer clearance from pose residuals.

criteria.negative: Decrease this world coordinate or world rotation-vector component.
criteria.hold: No correction within the supplied tolerance.
criteria.positive: Increase this world coordinate or world rotation-vector component.
